name: VoxCPM2
access: Hugging Face weights openbmb/VoxCPM2 (about 2.29B parameters in the file listing)
voxcpm Python package, OpenBMB/VoxCPM repository, Nano-vLLM production serving, llama.cpp-omni for on-device inference
Live playground on Hugging Face Spaces

voice.input_audio: Text, with an optional description or style note in parentheses at the start; optional reference audio (16 kHz accepted) with its transcript [hf-voxcpm2]
voice.output_audio: 48 kHz audio through the AudioVAE V2 with built-in super-resolution; a streaming generator is available [hf-voxcpm2]
voice.voices: voice design from a description; custom cloning in three modes (basic, controllable with style notes, and reference plus transcript) [hf-voxcpm2]
languages: 30 languages (Arabic, Burmese, Chinese, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Khmer, Korean, Lao, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese) and 9 Chinese dialects; no language tag needed [hf-voxcpm2]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback
voice.latency: OpenBMB: real-time factor about 0.30 on an RTX 4090, about 0.13 with Nano-vLLM; no time-to-first-audio figure on the pages read [hf-voxcpm2]
voice.session_limit: The model has a maximum sequence length of 8,192 tokens at a 6.25 Hz language-model token rate [hf-voxcpm2]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, free for commercial use under Apache-2.0. About 8 GB of GPU memory, with Python 3.10 or later, PyTorch 2.5 or later and CUDA 12 or later [hf-voxcpm2]. No hosted API price read
